brief:
Community organizations in Gaza have established a seed bank to safeguard local crop varieties and agricultural knowledge as the territory faces ongoing strain on its farming infrastructure. The initiative, known as the municipal seed bank, stores traditional seeds and works to maintain biodiversity across Gaza's agricultural sector.

The project addresses food security concerns by protecting heirloom varieties and farming practices developed over generations in the region, according to Maan Wire. Officials involved say the effort ensures that local agricultural heritage and crop genetics survive disruptions to Gaza's farming communities and land use patterns.
title: Gaza's municipal seed bank preserves crop varieties amid conflict
